statement: {V} [DecidableEq V] (S : Set V) (sw sx : Finset V) (w : V) (hsw : ↑sw ⊆ S \ {w}) : sw ∪ sx \ {w} = (sw ∪ sx) \ {w}
name: LinearAlgebraGame.union_diff_singleton_eq
content:
`union_diff_singleton_eq` is a helper proof that if `↑sw ⊆ S \ {w}`, then
`sw ∪ (sx \ {w}) = (sw ∪ sx) \ {w}`. The syntax is
`union_diff_singleton_eq S sw sx w hsw`.
